mapper.select: SELECT s.SHARE_ID, s.TODO_ID, s.SHARED_USER_ID, s.SHARED_BY_USER_ID, s.PERMISSION, s.CREATED_AT, s.CREATED_BY, su.NAME AS SHARED_USER_NAME, su.USERNAME AS SHARED_USERNAME, sb.NAME AS SHARED_BY_USER_NAME, sb.USERNAME AS SHARED_BY_USERNAME, t.TITLE AS TODO_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM TB_TODO_SHARE s INNER JOIN TB_USER su ON s.SHARED_USER_ID = su.USER_ID INNER JOIN TB_USER sb ON s.SHARED_BY_USER_ID = sb.USER_ID INNER JOIN TB_TODO t ON s.TODO_ID = t.TODO_ID LEFT JOIN TB_DEPARTMENT d ON su.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SHARE_ID = #{shareId}

SELECT s.SHARE_ID, s.TODO_ID, s.SHARED_USER_ID, s.SHARED_BY_USER_ID, s.PERMISSION, s.CREATED_AT, s.CREATED_BY, su.NAME AS SHARED_USER_NAME, su.USERNAME AS SHARED_USERNAME, sb.NAME AS SHARED_BY_USER_NAME, sb.USERNAME AS SHARED_BY_USERNAME, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM TB_TODO_SHARE s INNER JOIN TB_USER su ON s.SHARED_USER_ID = su.USER_ID INNER JOIN TB_USER sb ON s.SHARED_BY_USER_ID = sb.USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_DEPARTMENT d ON su.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.TODO_ID = #{todoId} ORDER BY s.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT s.SHARE_ID, s.TODO_ID, s.SHARED_USER_ID, s.SHARED_BY_USER_ID, s.PERMISSION, s.CREATED_AT, s.CREATED_BY, sb.NAME AS SHARED_BY_USER_NAME, sb.USERNAME AS SHARED_BY_USERNAME, t.TITLE AS TODO_TITLE, t.DUE_DATE AS TODO_DUE_DATE, t.DUE_TIME AS TODO_DUE_TIME, t.PRIORITY AS TODO_PRIORITY, ou.NAME AS TODO_OWNER_USER_NAME FROM TB_TODO_SHARE s INNER JOIN TB_TODO t ON s.TODO_ID = t.TODO_ID INNER JOIN TB_USER sb ON s.SHARED_BY_USER_ID = sb.USER_ID INNER JOIN TB_USER ou ON t.OWNER_USER_ID = ou.USER_ID WHERE s.SHARED_USER_ID = #{sharedUserId} AND t.USE_YN = 'Y' AND t.IS_COMPLETED = FALSE ORDER BY t.DUE_DATE ASC, t.DUE_TIME ASC, s.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT s.SHARE_ID, s.TODO_ID, s.SHARED_USER_ID, s.SHARED_BY_USER_ID, s.PERMISSION, s.CREATED_AT, s.CREATED_BY, su.NAME AS SHARED_USER_NAME, su.USERNAME AS SHARED_USERNAME, sb.NAME AS SHARED_BY_USER_NAME, sb.USERNAME AS SHARED_BY_USERNAME FROM TB_TODO_SHARE s INNER JOIN TB_USER su ON s.SHARED_USER_ID = su.USER_ID INNER JOIN TB_USER sb ON s.SHARED_BY_USER_ID = sb.USER_ID WHERE s.TODO_ID = #{todoId} AND s.SHARED_USER_ID = #{sharedUserId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_TODO_SHARE ( TODO_ID, SHARED_USER_ID, SHARED_BY_USER_ID, PERMISSION, CREATED_AT, CREATED_BY ) VALUES ( #{todoId}, #{sharedUserId}, #{sharedByUserId}, #{permission}, NOW(), #{createdBy} )
